description: Source code for a thermal monitoring class (CThermalMonitor) that interacts with hardware via IARM bus calls to get/set core temperature, thresholds, and overtemp grace intervals, and emits threshold change events.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: A singleton class providing thermal monitoring functionalities, including retrieving and setting temperature thresholds, overtemp grace intervals, and emitting threshold change events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer for thermal events (empty implementation).

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an event observer for thermal events.

methods.name: getCoreTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current core temperature via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves current temperature thresholds (high and critical) via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds (high and critical) via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the overtemperature grace interval via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Sets the overtemperature grace interval via IARM bus call.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits a temperature threshold change event.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Logs or reports a temperature threshold change event.
